en.summary: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman met with Syrian President Ahmad Al-Sharaa in Riyadh to review bilateral relations and explore cooperation opportunities across various fields and regional developments.

en.summary: A teenage girl attacked students at a school in Istanbul, killing one child and injuring others.

en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Health Ministry reported increased respiratory infections within expected seasonal levels and recommended eligible groups receive influenza and respiratory syncytial virus vaccines through the Sehhaty app.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia facilitates family entry for skilled workers

en.title: Saudi Arabia facilitates family entry for skilled workers
en.summary: Saudi Arabia introduced measures allowing skilled foreign workers to bring eligible family members while employment visa procedures are pending, aimed at improving residents' quality of life.

stories.title: Health Ministry urges vaccination amid rise in seasonal respiratory infections

en.title: Health Ministry urges vaccination amid rise in seasonal respiratory infections
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Health reported increased respiratory infections at seasonal expected levels and encouraged eligible groups to receive vaccines against influenza and RSV through the Sehhaty app, noting intensive care admissions rose approximately 30 percent over three weeks.

stories.title: Yemen lauds Saudi Arabia's decision to regularize status of Yemeni residents

en.title: Yemen lauds Saudi Arabia's decision to regularize status of Yemeni residents
en.summary: Yemen's government praised King Salman's directive to regularize the status of Yemeni nationals living illegally in Saudi Arabia, calling it a humanitarian gesture reflecting the countries' historical ties and brotherhood.

stories.title: Yemenis welcome move to regularize residency status in Saudi Arabia

en.title: Yemenis welcome move to regularize residency status in Saudi Arabia
en.summary: Yemeni citizens expressed gratitude following King Salman's directive to correct the residency status of Yemenis living illegally in Saudi Arabia, responding to a request from Yemen's Presidential Leadership Council President.

en.title: Saudi Arabia allows highly skilled expats to bring families alongside work visa process
en.summary: Saudi Arabia announced new measures permitting highly skilled foreign workers to bring eligible family members during work visa processing, allowing heads of households to sponsor spouses and children under specified conditions.

en.summary: Syrian President Ahmed Al-Sharaa visited Riyadh on Tuesday for an official meeting with Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, accompanied by Syria's Foreign Minister.

en.title: Gulf economies set for 10.3% rebound in 2027 if oil flows rebound: World Bank
en.summary: The World Bank projects Gulf economies could grow 10.3 percent in 2027 if regional oil production normalizes and the Iran conflict does not worsen, allowing trade and tourism to recover.

stories.title: ‎Saudi banks see easing funding pressures: Moody’s

en.title: Saudi banks see easing funding pressures: Moody's
en.summary: Moody's Ratings indicates that Saudi banks are experiencing moderated loan growth paired with deposit increases that alleviate funding constraints. The agency does not expect the credit cycle to end soon due to ongoing financing needs and the economy's diversification efforts.
